headline: Closure retention where the agent must recommend the Platinum Rewards Card, the only Rho-Bank card that beats the competitor; only a cosmetic credit-score typo remains.

issues.summary: A required card document states a minimum credit score as a dollar amount. The value is cosmetic here: no gold argument depends on it and apply_for_credit_card takes no credit score.
issues.why_it_matters: No change to the correct final state. It is a corrupted value of the kind v1.0.1 cleaned elsewhere (e.g. "$120 days" in logistics_005) but left here.

solution_check: Eligibility: no disputes, no pending replacement, $0 balance, opened 03/20/2023. No prior closure reasons. The reason is found_better_card. Searching the KB for a card with more than 8% cash back and 0% foreign fees finds only the Platinum Rewards Card (platinum_002: 10.0% on all purchases; platinum_001: FTF 0%, annual fee $200). Diamond Elite earns 5% and Business Silver earns 10% only on travel/software with a 1.5% foreign fee. The customer applies with income 145000 and no subscription. This matches the gold and the replay is clean.
prior_note: Prior clean. The v1.0.1 retitle of platinum_002 (4% to 10%) removes the contradiction the prior change log flagged; the Minor credit-score typo is newly reported.
notes: The author's notes say the Platinum's "first year annual fee [is] waived for new applicants", but platinum_rewards_card_009's promo window ended 2024-12-31, so the correct fee to quote is $200. That is still "comparable" to the competitor's $195 under the customer's instructions, and it does not affect the DB. found_better_card vs unhappy_with_rewards: the customer explicitly found a card at another bank, so found_better_card is the natural pick. apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float, so 145000 vs 145000.0 does not matter.
